site.customer_role: factory shift supervisor in a simple slate work jacket
site.interior: an illustrated staff briefing room with a cream-painted wall and a window facing the loading courtyard
site.qa_action: The shift supervisor gestures toward coworkers behind the window. The representative listens, then answers with an open palm.
site.street: a fictional industrial access road, low blue warehouse roofs, painted lane markings and a distant loading canopy
site.entrance: a warehouse personnel entrance with a pale-gray steel door, narrow window, blue canopy and yellow painted step

hardware.identity: one T-LINKON COMPACT handheld PTT radio from the product reference

hardware.grip: one palm cradles the small radio upright, fingers around the sides with the front and antenna visible; keep the other hand free for the door
hardware.scope: 가상 구성의 제품 형태를 보여주는 공식 자료. 실제 공장 설치 사진은 별도 입력.

map.scope: 두 좌표는 새 경로의 입력 형식을 보여 주는 가상 사례 대표점이다. 실제 고객 또는 티링크 출발 주소를 나타내지 않는다.
